parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to configure a whitelist of public IP addresses.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: WhiteList
parameters.description: The IP address whitelist that you want to configure.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-white-list --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --white-list 10.162.XX.XX,192.168.XX.XX --white-list-policies Entry=10.162.XX.XX,192.168.XX.XX Description=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
